metrics.ttft: Client time from starting the request to receiving the first generated text, including reasoning. Includes network, queueing, and prefill; queueing time is not measured separately.
metrics.tpot: Time per output token: (last token − first token) ÷ (tokens − 1), decode phase only.
metrics.tps: Decode speed of this request = 1000 / TPOT, excluding prefill and TTFT.
metrics.prefill: Prompt tokens ÷ TTFT. TTFT includes network and queueing, so this is a lower bound on prefill speed; a prefix-cache hit inflates it.
metrics.tokens: Tokens generated so far, from the usage the endpoint reports.
metrics.tokensApproximate: The endpoint reported no usage, so tokens are estimated from stream chunks (about one token each); values marked ≈ are estimates.
